what: Input and output as hex, so the comparison never passes through a text encoder that could normalise either one.

cases.name: bom
cases.why: a byte-order mark, which is a character and not a marker

cases.name: crlf
cases.why: CRLF line endings, which nothing may fold

cases.name: nul
cases.why: a NUL inside a string

cases.name: astral
cases.why: one code point, two UTF-16 units, one surrogate pair on the way out

cases.name: astral_raw
cases.why: and the same with ensure_ascii off, where it stays four UTF-8 bytes

cases.name: combining
cases.why: a combining sequence, which has a composed form nothing may normalise to

cases.name: composed
cases.why: and the composed form, which must stay distinct from it

cases.name: cjk
cases.why: a reply in Chinese, escaped

cases.name: cjk_raw
cases.why: and unescaped

cases.name: smart_quotes
cases.why: the curly pair, which the parser reads and the writer must give back

cases.name: low_smart_quote
cases.why: the low one, which opens a span no other rule closes

cases.name: control_run
cases.why: every control character JSON has a short name for

cases.name: control_no_short_name
cases.why: and one that has none, which stays escaped even with ensure_ascii off, since JSON requires it either way

cases.name: del
cases.why: DEL, which is escaped only when ensure_ascii is on

cases.name: del_raw
cases.why: and left alone when it is not

cases.name: latin1_high
cases.why: a high Latin-1 character, two UTF-8 bytes

cases.name: boundary_two_byte_first
cases.why: U+0080, the first two-byte character

cases.name: boundary_two_byte_first_raw
cases.why: and raw

cases.name: boundary_two_byte_last
cases.why: U+07FF, the last

cases.name: boundary_three_byte_first
cases.why: U+0800, the first three-byte

cases.name: boundary_bmp_last
cases.why: U+FFFF, the top of the basic plane

cases.name: boundary_bmp_last_raw
cases.why: and raw

cases.name: boundary_astral_first
cases.why: U+10000, the smallest surrogate pair

cases.name: boundary_astral_last
cases.why: U+10FFFF, the largest code point there is

cases.name: boundary_astral_last_raw
cases.why: which is four UTF-8 bytes raw

cases.name: escape_beside_multibyte
cases.why: an escape flanked by multi-byte characters, which is where a span-copying writer's bookkeeping is off by one if it ever is

cases.name: escape_beside_multibyte_ascii
cases.why: the same, escaped to ASCII

cases.name: multibyte_key_ascii
cases.why: a key past ASCII under ensure_ascii, since keys escape too
